latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Session Archivist – automated session file compression and archival for Hermes.

- Detects oversized session files and auto-archives when they exceed 1MB.
- Scores message importance to retain only critical content during compression.
- Flushes key memory to archive before trimming session files, preventing data loss.
- Generates structured summaries and supports conflict/de-duplication handling.
- Integrates with Hindsight memory if available, falls back to local markdown storage otherwise.
- Includes safety checks to avoid race conditions and supports automated scheduling via cron.
